title: Hai già vinta la causa!
subtitle: The Count: recitative and aria from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 3 (No. 17)

facts.tempo: Maestoso, Presto, Andante and Allegro in the recitative; Allegro maestoso at ♩ = 132, then Allegro assai at ♩ = 152 (about 5 minutes)

note: The Count realises he may have been tricked, and vows revenge
about: Score: No. 17, the Count's recitative “Hai già vinta la causa!” and aria “Vedrò, mentr'io sospiro” (vocal score pages 216-223, 160 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
